documents.title: Book Closure For The Purpose Of 34Th AGM
Addendum To The Boards'' Report For The Financial Year 2025-26 Which Forms An Integral Part Of The 34Th Annual Report

analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems published its investor presentation outlining robust Q1 FY2026-27 financial and operational performance, including standalone revenue of ₹502.03 crores and a total order book of ₹5,174 crores with ₹3,487 crores remaining to be executed. Management detailed expanding manufacturing capacities, robust banking limits and undrawn headroom, and an aggressive business diversification roadmap entering domains like Yard Management, Intelligent Traffic Management, Data Centres, Simulators, and AI-BIM Digital Twins. The company highlighted its strong market position as a Kavach OEM with RDSO Version 4.0 approval and significant future order pipeline projections through FY29. Kernex Microsystems reported its financial and operational performance for Q3 FY25 and 9M FY25, highlighting substantial revenue growth, improved EBITDA and PAT margins, and extensive details regarding its Kavach and TCAS project execution. Management outlined its production capacity for Kavach units and level crossing gates alongside a robust order book value of 2,124.16 Crs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that Indian Railways adds approximately 5 new locomotives daily, continuously growing the national rolling stock asset base.
demand_outlook.quote: Expanding Fleet Baseline: Indian Railways adds ~approx 5 new locomotives daily (~1,900+ per annum), continuously growing the national rolling stock asset base.

demand_outlook.claim: Mandatory regulatory tailwinds dictate that 100% of newly manufactured rolling stock must be eventually outfitted with ATP/Kavach modules prior to commissioning.
demand_outlook.quote: Mandatory Regulatory Tailwinds: Per Mandate 100% of newly manufactured rolling stock must be eventually outfitted with (ATP/ KAVACH) modules prior to commissioning.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian Railways Pink book planned an execution of ~Rs 35,000 Crores opportunity for Kavach over the next 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: Railway’sPinkbookhasalready plannedanexecutionof ~Rs 35,000 Crores Opportunity Kavachfornext5 yrs

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding capacity in advance of order inflow and mobilizing resources ahead of anticipated awards.
capex_expansion.quote: Capacity build-out ahead of demand: The Company is expanding capacity in advance of order inflow. Recruitment of technical and project personnel is under way on a forward-looking basis, and engineering, installation and commissioning resources are being mobilised ahead of anticipated awards, so that execution capability is established before contracts are received.

orders_capacity.claim: The production capacity stands at 450 Kavach Units per month.
The total value of the order book as on date is 2,124.16 Crs.
orders_capacity.quote: Total Value of order book as on: 2,124.16 Crs

orders_capacity.claim: The order book comprises CLW at 1,730 Crs.
The South Eastern Railway order stands at 179.21 Crs.
The KMIL Exclusive order book is 1,735.38 Crs.
Production capacity for Kavach units is 100 units per month, which can scale up to 250 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: • 100 Kavach Units/Month , can scale up to 250 Units/Month

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity for Level Crossing Gates is 10 Level Crossing Gates per month, expandable up to 25 Units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: • 10 Level Crossing Gates/Month, Can scale up to 25 Units/Month

management_commitments.claim: The company expects cumulative new EPC orders of 41,000 KM across FY27 to FY29.
management_commitments.quote: Total new EPC orders expected: 41,000 KM cumulative across FY27-29.

management_commitments.claim: For the NCR A project (GZB – CNB), the GZB to CNB execution is scheduled by June 2025.
management_commitments.quote: NCR A: GZB – CNB (GZB – CNB by June 2025, Supply Completed, 70% Execution completed)

management_commitments.claim: For the NCR B project (CNB – DDN), the CNB to ALD section is scheduled by June 2025.
management_commitments.quote: NCR B: CNB – DDN (CNB – ALD by June 2025, ALD – DDN ….. It may take few more months(15%), 60% Execution completed)

management_commitments.claim: The Lx-Gates of ENR are scheduled for completion by June 2025.
The Automatic Block Signalling project will be completed as per schedule by December 2025.
management_commitments.quote: Project will be completed as per schedule-Dec 2025

management_commitments.claim: For the CLW Project, material supplies started from the second week of April 2025.
management_commitments.quote: Materials supply started from 2nd week of April 2025

management_commitments.claim: For the CLW Project, delivery is expected to start by the end of May 2025.
management_commitments.quote: Expected to start delivery by end of May 2025

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
